name: O'Hare Precision
verdict: The biggest movement is a 57.14% drop in Google Business Profile actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely driven by reduced local search visibility or seasonal demand softening. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads over the 28-day window, meaning all 182 GBP actions (including 11 calls and 127 direction requests) represent the only active lead-gen activity for O'Hare Precision.

performance.verdict: Paid channels dead; organic GBP collapsing; 6 SOW blockers overdue.

findings.text: 4 CRM milestones overdue (earliest Jul 7): 342 stub reconciliation (blocker Aug 31) and Tom call list (Jul 28) still unresolved, gating Sales-i pipeline.
Web/SEO root-cause fix and AGS+Forte contact pull both missed Aug 31 deadline; both flagged as blockers in SOW.
Zero paid spend and zero paid leads across all 28 days; CPL is undefined. No paid channel is active — this is not an efficiency problem, it is an absence.
GBP actions dropped 57% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 29–31) show 0 actions vs prior 3-day avg of ~2.7, confirming the decline is accelerating, not stabilising.
Search clicks fell 17% week-over-week; Aug 30–31 show 0 clicks each, vs a 45-day daily avg of ~14.4, suggesting a visibility or indexing issue, not just seasonality.

suggestions.text: Escalate 342 stub reconciliation to Ahmed immediately; this blocker stops Sales-i syncing for all affected accounts.
suggestions.monday_update: The 342 stub reconciliation was due 2026-08-31 and remains incomplete, blocking Sales-i from syncing Customer ID data to Sugar for all affected accounts. Ahmed to confirm a revised completion date by 2026-09-03 and post the audited batch file with rollback to the Monday CRM board. Success is confirmed when all 342 stubs have matched Customer IDs and the Sales-i sync no longer skips them. Re-check 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Name the Web/SEO root cause and submit fix; AGS+Forte contact pull must be delivered — both are Aug 31 blockers.
suggestions.monday_update: Both the Web/SEO root-cause fix and the AGS+Forte contact pull missed the 2026-08-31 deadline and are listed as blockers in the SOW. The responsible team members should post the named root cause and fix submission to Monday by 2026-09-03, and deliver the AGS+Forte contact list by the same date. Success is confirmed when both items are marked complete with artefacts attached. Re-check 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions and search clicks for 3 more days; 0 actions on Aug 29–31 may be a data lag, not a confirmed collapse.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for the last 3 days of August (Aug 29–31), and search clicks also read 0 on Aug 30–31 — both metrics need one more full data cycle to rule out reporting lag. No action on paid channels is warranted until the root-cause fix (S2) is resolved and GBP data confirms whether this is a visibility drop or a tracking gap. Re-check on 2026-09-04 with fresh GBP action counts; if the 3-day avg remains below 1, escalate as a confirmed visibility issue.
